audit.why: phases[0..6].side all read Galio and win[0..6] all read Galio, matching packet.levelChart exactly — the only matchup in this slice whose chart layers already agree. Difficulty FAVOURED at 4/10 is consistent with the 51.87% figure over 3736 games.

audit.whatIsWrong: The spike fields never carried Fizz's real timings — Playful / Trickster falling from 16s at rank 1 to 8s at rank 5 is the only spike that changes the lane.
audit.why: His threat window is a cooldown window: at rank 5 the untargetable hop is up almost every trade, while Chum the Waters stays at 120s at rank 1.
audit.corrected: breakdown.cooldowns, dosFull[1].d and dontsFull[0].d now carry those numbers.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns had no digit (lint COOLDOWN_NO_DIGIT) and the page never stated the two decisive interactions: your W keeps charging while he is untargetable, and Justice Punch's knockup is the answer to Urchin Strike.
audit.why: Playful / Trickster makes him untargetable, so burst spent into it is wasted, but Shield of Durand is a charge-then-release taunt — starting it during the hop lands it on his return. Galio's E knocks up the first champion it reaches, and Urchin Strike (550 range) is Fizz's only way in.
audit.corrected: Stated in breakdown.cooldowns, dosFull[0].d and dontsFull[2].d.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.carry, breakdown.late and ahead were champion-generic Galio boilerplate that would read identically against any enemy.
audit.why: Against Fizz the specific fact is Chum the Waters: a 1300-range fish that commits him to the target it sticks to, and a knockup that fights your own R knockup.
audit.corrected: All three rewritten around the shark's travel time and his commit.

edits.before: - Fizz Playful / Trickster: matchup-defining — The untargetable hop dodges your whole combo — bait it before spending your burst. Step up only on its downtime. - Budget W Shield of Durand for emergencies and the R for opportunities — never swap them.
edits.after: - Playful / Trickster: 16s at rank 1, 8s at rank 5 — the hop is untargetable, so anything you spend during it is wasted. - Chum the Waters: 120s at rank 1, and it knocks up. - Urchin Strike is 8s at 550 range; that is his only way in.

edits.before: The untargetable hop dodges your whole combo — bait it before spending your burst. Commit on its cooldown, never into it.
edits.after: He has to land next to you to slam — hold the W charge through the untargetable window and taunt him on the way down.

edits.before: Q the contact, let the tornado tick, E-auto if he answers, W-taunt the commit — a full rotation where his half landed on a shield.
edits.after: Playful / Trickster is 16s at rank 1 — when the second hop puts him back at range, Winds of War is the only thing that still reaches him.

edits.before: That is Fizz’s whole plan in one window — decline politely and watch it retire.
edits.after: A feint pulls the W charge, then Urchin Strike arrives on an 8-second cooldown.

edits.before: Charging W through a minion line at a mage holding his answer — the statue mid-charge is the lane's easiest skillshot target.
edits.after: Justice Punch is your knockup answer to Urchin Strike — leave with it on cooldown and Fizz dives the wave you left behind.

edits.before: Fizz wins by landing Playful / Trickster, denying your pattern, and starting the fight your kit wanted ten seconds later.
edits.after: Fizz wins by dodging your W inside Playful / Trickster, sticking Chum the Waters on you, and killing you during the knockup.

edits.before: Carry through arrivals — Hero's Entrance turns every losing skirmish your team starts into a 5v4 with a knockup.
edits.after: Carry by punishing the fish: Chum the Waters is 1300 range, and once it is on you, Fizz commits — taunt him as he lands.

edits.before: You are the anti-dive: taunt their engage off your carry, shield the magic, and R the flank their comp built around.
edits.after: You are the anti-dive: taunt Fizz off your carry, and never spend the R while the shark is still travelling toward someone.

edits.before: Ahead, tax both maps: zone Fizz with taunt threat, keep the wave middle, and R every skirmish — fed Galio makes the enemy jungler unemployed.
edits.after: Ahead, deny the reset: Fizz needs Chum the Waters to start a fight, so hold the wave middle and taunt him the moment the fish is airborne.
